content: Mereka bermaksud pindah ke kota lain
sebelum anak mereka masuk sekolah.
= They intend to move to another city
before their child starts school.
Lesson 10 put ber- on things you can see:
berdiri, berjalan, bersepeda. On an idea it
does the same work, and the result stops
looking like a verb at all.
maksud  ->  bermaksud   to intend
harga   ->  berharga    valuable
tindak  ->  bertindak   to act
sikap   ->  bersikap    to behave
berharga is an adjective. bermaksud takes
a whole verb after it. Neither has an
object, and that is ber- all over.
Some of them close with -an as well, and
then the pair means together, or all round.
bersamaan     at the same moment   Press 1
berhubungan   connected to         Press 2
berlebihan    too much of it       Press 3
Dua kereta itu tiba bersamaan di stasiun
kecil pagi tadi.
= Those two trains arrived at the same
time at the small station this morning.
berbagai and berikut are the two that fool
everyone. berbagai jenis is various kinds;
nama berikut is the next name. Neither is a
verb, and neither doubles the noun after
it.
Kalau kamu menulis surat resmi, tulislah
demikian supaya pembacanya tidak salah
paham.
= If you are writing a formal letter,
write it that way so your reader does
not misunderstand.
demikian means in that way. You will never
hear it in a market. It belongs to the page
and so do the words beside it.
terutama   above all, especially
yaitu      namely, that is
sengaja    on purpose
selagi     while, as long as
sekaligus  in one go, and also
Four of them turn a sentence against what
the reader expected.
malah      instead, the reverse    Press 1
justru     the very opposite       Press 2
melainkan  but rather              Press 3
sekalipun  even if, even though    Press 4
Obat yang dibeli di warung kecil itu
tidak menolong, malah membuat perutnya
sakit.
= The medicine from that stall did not
help; instead it made his stomach hurt.
Inti masalah itu bukan uang, melainkan
kepercayaan antara dua pihak.
= The heart of it is not money but trust
between the two sides.

pronunciation_mappings.1: Obat itu tidak menolong, malah membuat perutnya sakit.
pronunciation_mappings.4: Sekalipun hujan turun, pedagang itu tetap membuka kedainya.

content: Dua kereta itu tiba bersamaan di stasiun
kecil pagi tadi.
= Those two trains arrived at the same
time at the small station this morning.
That is the last card of Pareto 1. Two
thousand words behind you, and the whole
machine fits on one page.
meN-          does something  melihat
ber-          is or has it    berjalan
di-           is done to it   ditulis
ter-          simply is       terbuka
peN-          the one who     penjual
peN- ... -an  the doing       penjualan
per- ... -an  the system      perdagangan
ke- ... -an   the state       kesalahan
-an           the thing       tulisan
Two endings sit inside the verb rather than
around it:
-kan   hands the thing over  memberikan
-i     points at the target  menghubungi
And two habits are not affixes at all:
se-          one of, or with   seorang
word-word    plural or manner  anak-anak
To read any long word, peel from the
outside in and stop at the first word you
know. Put back p, t, k or s if the prefix
ate it.
Selamat. Anda sudah sampai.        Press 1
= Well done. You have got this far.

pronunciation_mappings.1: Selamat. Anda sudah sampai di sini.
